lines: Lured by the warm sunlight, my desire for a stroll was stirred, and I set out on a leisurely, aimless journey.
I called it a journey, but I was just wandering around familiar places with no particular purpose.
Clear was standing in front of Yukikaze's house, wearing unfamiliar clothes.
Clear, having noticed my presence, approached me, looking a bit stiff in her movements.
You seem to be moving awkwardly.
It's really hard to move, but I'll get used to it soon, so it's fine.
It's not just "bye." Why are you trying to leave so quickly? You're always so free.
Ugh... You really know how to hit me where it hurts...
I thought we were done after a simple greeting, but apparently Clear didn't think so.
Fuuma, aren't you curious about what I'm doing in this outfit?
Clear proudly showed off her costume, along with a mysterious snake and butterfly.
She really wanted me to ask what she was doing.
Honestly, I wasn't uninterested, but being pushed like that just made me want to tease her more. That's just how men are.
Good job managing to wear the kimono properly.
Clear nodded proudly and continued to show off her kimono.
Going isn't good. I should ask what you're doing.
I didn't want to tease her any more, so I decided to stop there.
What were you doing in such a fancy kimono?
I've become well-behaved again. No, that's not what I meant.
Clear was doing a bit of self-correction. She was cute, like a small animal.
Sorry, sorry. So, what were you doing?
I was imitating the shinobi who supposedly existed in the past. I heard about them from Oboro.
Ah, the Kunoichi who came from the past. The Iga Tsuba Kakure Shu, right?
Yes, that's it. I heard stories about the members of the Iga Tsuba Kakure Shu from Oboro, and I was trying to imitate one of them.
Watching Clear speak with such delight, I couldn't help but feel happy myself.
By the way, are that butterfly and the white snake real?
My eyes caught the butterflies fluttering around Clear and the white snake coiled around her arm, so I asked her.
As you can see, they are fakes. Linoa, Kiryu Sabato's assistant, made them.
The moment Clear thrust her hand forward and formed a seal, the white snake lunged at a straw effigy mimicking an enemy, and the glowing butterflies danced in the air.
I couldn't tell if she was happy because it worked well or because she was praised, but Clear wore a thoroughly satisfied expression.
But seriously, both the white snake and the butterfly are incredibly intricate. You can't tell they aren't real.
I was so impressed by Linoa's skill that I reached out to touch the mechanical white snake.
As Clear's panicked voice reached my ears, a sharp pain shot through my outstretched right hand.
I looked down at my right hand in surprise to find the mechanical white snake biting into it tightly.
It has an automatic defense response. I managed to control it in the nick of time, but... did it hurt?
I'm probably fine... but more importantly... can you get that off?
Red liquid was flowing from the bite marks made by the mechanical white snake.
You're bleeding... My snake did this, so it's my fault...
Don't make a big deal out of it. The wound is shallow, so the bleeding will stop soon.
I could have teased her like before, but seeing Clear genuinely upset, I couldn't bring myself to do it.
Besides, it's not your fault. I was careless for reaching out. I should be the one apologizing. I'm sorry.
Besides, it will heal right away, so please don't worry.
Trying to reassure Clear, I acted cheerfully on purpose while searching for supplies to stop the bleeding.
Responsibility...!? What do you think you're doing!?
Clear gently lifted my hand, which was still leaking a bit of blood, with both hands and stared at the wound. I couldn't help but feel my heart skip a beat at her face.
A soft, squishy sensation and a luscious warmth were transmitted through my fingertips.
You really don't have to do this, I'm fine. Stop it... okay...?
I tried my best to make her stop, but Clear refused to let go of my finger.
Chu, nmu, nn... That's what you do when you get hurt. Kiryu taught me... nnn...
Nku, aah...! N-no, no way... aah!
I can't focus on the treatment if you make those gross sounds.
I was forced to stop the loud moan that had slipped out because my finger was being sucked.
In the old days, when there were no medical devices or tools, we healed wounds this way. Kiryu told me so... nmu, nn...
But now, we have medical devices and tools, so you don't have to do this...
But they aren't here right now. Nmu, chu...
If we went into Yukikaze's house, there would be plenty of first aid supplies.
But it didn't feel bad, so I decided to keep quiet about it.
First aid supplies. They are in Yukikaze's house. But that won't do.
If I don't do it the way Kiryu taught me, it would be bad for Kiryu who took the trouble to teach me.
(Ah, you knew that... Of course you do... You're a guest, after all...)
I felt a bit disappointed, but at the same time, a question arose: why are you doing this then? That is what it means to be human.
I was defeated by her immediate, almost pleasurable response. I couldn't help but agree.
Besides, it's my responsibility for the injury. I was too absorbed in showing you. Chuu, nm, nnn...
The scene before me was so erotic that the feeling of being treated faded away unconsciously.
Ngu, nn... leroo, njju, nnn... Fuuma... it doesn't hurt...?
I'm fine, but... you don't have to go this far...
Clear, who had my finger deep in her mouth, seemed worried, so I spoke to her, but she shook her head slightly.
Just do whatever you want, Clear...
Do whatever I want... um, jiburu, nnn... leryu, nm, chuuuu...
Clear gently closed her eyes and licked my wound softly, careful not to cause pain.
The sensation of the glossy, warm mucus and flesh clinging to my fingertips caused blood to rush to my groin without me realizing it.
This is treatment... it's definitely not that kind of thing... calm down, me... I need to calm down right now...
I managed to talk my body, which was starting to misunderstand the situation, into stopping, just barely preventing my groin from swelling.
Nmu, chu, leroo... n...? I taste Fuuma... nmu, nn...
I didn't miss her small whisper as she gazed at my finger with eyes that had completely melted.
My taste...? It's just the taste of iron...?
Leroo, njju, nn... No... this is Fuuma's taste... nmu, chu... it's not just the taste of iron.
Seeing Clear lick my finger around with a look of delight, my groin reacted again, but I somehow managed to suppress it once more.
It feels like... I'm doing something incredibly wrong...
Letting her, with a face so childish it was almost criminal, lick my finger. Strictly speaking, I am the one being licked, but that's not the issue.
Making this girl do such a thing felt deeply transgressive, evoking a certain kind of decadence.
Precisely because it wasn't direct, it felt even more decadent and transgressive, stirring my groin far more than it should have.
(If I keep this up, it's really going to get bad...)
Honestly, being treated like this, I had no confidence that I wouldn't make a mistake.
I was an ugly clown, trapped between desire and a sense of ethics, forced to keep dancing an awkward dance.
(I have to try my best not to look...)
To avert my eyes from reality, I physically looked away.
(Don't lick me while making such lewd sounds!)
The downside of looking away came sooner than I expected.
Because I wasn't looking, the decadent sounds became even more prominent in my ears.
(Grr... hold on, me... I have to endure this...)
I clenched my muscles hard to force the blood flowing to my groin back up to my brain.
Nmu, chu... Hm? Fuuma's taste is gone...
My head felt like it was about to burst from the strain, but thanks to that, or perhaps thanks to being licked so much, the bleeding seemed to have stopped without me noticing.
Mm... The bleeding has stopped, but... the wound isn't gone...
If the bleeding has stopped, you're fine now. Thanks for treating me. I owe you one.
It's not healed yet. Hm, nchu, nnn...
No... Ogh, nggh... haa haa... Gub, ujju, nguuu...!
My finger, once again enveloped in Clear's mucous membranes, was clamped down deep to the base.
Guaah...! This is bad! You're really a bad one...
Nju, ugh... I can't focus on the treatment if you make sounds like a girl... nnn!
I didn't mean to, ahhh...! I'm not doing it on purpose, nhyii...!!
Ugh, nnngh, ogh, nngh! Fuuma... nnngh, nngh... gulp!
Clear sank her teeth into the base of my confused finger.
A dull pain shot through me, and I instinctively pulled my hand back to check the bitten area.
Phew... It doesn't look like it's bleeding...
As far as I could tell, there was no blood coming from my finger. However, Clear's tooth marks were left clearly imprinted on it.
I was just a little surprised, so it's fine.
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
Watching Clear apologize repeatedly with tears in her eyes, a single question arose in my mind.
I spoke gently to avoid startling Clear, and she answered me while holding back tears in her eyes.
I don't know... I don't know why I bit you... I really don't understand, but I'm sorry...
From the way she answered, flustered and fumbling, I could painfully understand that she truly didn't know why she had done such a thing.
Even after the bleeding stopped, she had checked my finger over and over again. I remembered how she had muttered each time that it hadn't healed yet, that the wound hadn't disappeared.
(Perhaps she was subconsciously jealous that the White Snake gave me a scar that wouldn't disappear immediately.)
So, thinking that Clear was trying to overwrite it by inflicting a wound on me in the same way as the White Snake, everything made sense.
My eyes fell on the mechanical White Snake lying motionless at Clear's feet, as if its battery had run out, while she continued to apologize desperately with teary eyes.
Clear... come to think of it... whose imitation is that outfit?
This is Hotaru... Arashi's friend? That aside, I'm sorry... I'll apologize as many times as it takes, I'm sorry.
It's fine now, so don't worry about it.
To calm Clear down, I gently patted her head while pondering the name she had mentioned.
I'm really sorry... I won't do anything like this again, so please forgive me. I'm reflecting on my actions.
It's okay. It's not Clear's fault.
Why? It's all my fault. I... I...
Clear, is there anything you want to eat?
I don't know. I'm not in the mood for that right now. I'm crying.
I'll forgive you once you stop crying.
Then I won't cry anymore. I want Fuuma to forgive me.
You cute thing. In consideration of your cuteness, I'll let you eat something delicious.
I had vaguely heard about Hotaru's character from before.
They said she was loving and devoted to a degree that made those around her fear her.
(Maybe Clear was trying to imitate Hotaru and got caught up in that kind of feeling a little...)
